    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersOutback pub sausage rollsPork sausage rolls in puff pastry with sesame seeds, tomato sauceHow to make it500g pork sausage mince1 brown onion1 carrot1 tbsp mixed dried herbs2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg1 tbsp sesame seedstomato sauce, to serveGrate the onion and carrot and mix through the sausage mince with the herbs.Lay the mince along each pastry sheet, roll up, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.Cut into 16 pieces and bake at 200°C until puffed and golden. Serve with tomato sauce.Alice Springs damperOven-baked damper loaf with butter and golden syrupHow to make it100g butter450g self-raising flour1 tsp salt300ml full cream milkgolden syrup, to serveRub a portion of the butter into the flour and salt, add the milk and mix to a soft dough.Shape into a round and cut a cross on top.Bake at 200°C until it sounds hollow when tapped.Serve warm with the rest of the butter and golden syrup.Coober Pedy opal jelly gemsThe underground opal mining townHow to make itAs written, serves 4Shimmering cubes of blue, green and purple jelly set inside clear lemon jelly and cut into chunks, with a little edible glitter like raw opal.Make three 85g packets of blue, green and purple jelly with 250ml boiling water each, set in shallow trays for 2 hours and cut into small cubes.Soak 6 gelatine leaves, dissolve in 500ml hot lemonade with 2 tbsp lemon juice and cool.Scatter the cubes into a lined 20cm tin, pour over the clear jelly and set 3 hours.Cut into chunks and dust with edible glitter.Devils on horsebackBernadette's table manners. Mullets not welcome.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsPepperberry kangaroo with sweet potatoSeared kangaroo fillet with roast sweet potato wedges and warm plum sauceHow to make it800g kangaroo fillet1 tsp ground pepperberry2 garlic cloves2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil800g sweet potato1/2 cup plum sauceCut the sweet potato into wedges, toss in oil and roast at 200°C.Rub the kangaroo with the pepperberry, crushed garlic and oil.Roast the wedges until golden.Sear the fillet hard in a hot pan to keep it rare.Rest the fillet, then slice. Warm the plum sauce and serve alongside.Bob's roadside barbecueBob the mechanic who helps them out on the roadHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thick beef snags grilled slowly, rosemary and garlic lamb chops, fried onions and a tomato, cucumber and red onion salad, served on the tailgate.Marinate 8 lamb chops in olive oil, rosemary, 2 crushed garlic cloves and lemon zest for 30 minutes.Cook 8 thick beef sausages over medium coals for 15 minutes, turning.Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate with oil until soft and golden.Grill the chops 3 minutes a side.Toss 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 cucumber and half a red onion with oil, vinegar and salt.Serve with bread and sauce.SweetsFrock on a rock pavlovaMeringue with whipped cream, passionfruit and strawberriesHow to make it4 eggs220g caster sugar1 tsp cornflour1 tsp white vinegar300ml thickened cream3 passionfruits250g strawberriesWhip the egg whites to soft peaks, add the sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in the cornflour and vinegar.Shape on a lined tray and bake at 120°C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven with the door closed.Cool completely in the oven.Whip the cream and top the pavlova with cream, passionfruit and sliced strawberries.DrinksBernadette's pink champagne belliniRaspberry and peach purée topped with sparkling roséHow to make it150g raspberries1 ripe peach1 tbsp sugar syrup150ml sparkling roseBlend most of the raspberries with the peach and sugar syrup until smooth, then strain.Spoon the purée into four chilled flutes.Top slowly with cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.Gin with lemon and AngosturaSipped on the bus roof, frock flapping.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
